events.name: list_unknowns
events.text: U1: "Motorised robot or vehicle" and "Microcontroller-driven output" fit almost equally well. Next: Evidence for or against: no motors (a moving machine is a robot, not a blinker). U2: Only one side of the board is visible, so connections come from the pattern, not from traced copper. Next: A photo of the back of the board. U3: Not visible: the jumper wires from the Uno's pins to IN1-IN4 are bundled and can't be followed. U4: O1 is a programmable controller, so the blink pattern is set by its firmware, which pixels can't read. Next: Read the firmware over USB if it isn't locked (Arduino IDE or esptool), or ask the owner for the sketch. U5: Pixels can't show voltages. Next: Part 3: the RECON probe measures what photos can't (a 555's timing capacitor should swing between one third and two thirds of the supply).
